deploymentEvidence.sourceType: pinned official mainnet alUSD V2 deployment artifact plus exact-address proxy resolution
deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official AlchemistV2_alUSD.json identifies this exact address; adjacent .chainId is 1. This is V2 alUSD, not V1 Alchemist, V2 alETH or V3. Both Etherscan and Sourcify report the implementation recorded below.

historicalOfficialImplementation.decision: not used as applicable implementation or ABI; differs from exact-address reported current implementation

lifecycleEvidence.statement: Official migration reference says V2-to-V3 migration completed April 2026; V2 user-facing functions were disabled to freeze positions. This independently corroborates the verified implementation bodies, not continued V2 availability.

limitations: Explorer/Sourcify proxy resolution is evidence-service observation, not a live RPC/storage/bytecode attestation.
No assumption is made that historical official artifacts still describe proxy behavior; proxy upgrades can replace the implementation.

abiEvidence.sourceType: complete exact-address verified implementation ABI bound through proxy resolution
abiEvidence.evidence: Top-level abi is the complete applicable implementation ABI, including 79 functions, not a generic V2 interface or historical deployment ABI. proxyAbi separately retains the full verified proxy ABI; proxyFunctionInventory reviews all five proxy function entries including transparent admin() selector dispatch. Constructors, receive and fallback create no capabilities.

reviewSummary.reason: No ordinary entry/exit subset remains functional in the exact applicable implementation; every deposit, withdrawal, mint, delegated mint, burn, repayment and self-liquidation entry point unconditionally reverts. No catalog capabilities or frontend card should be added.

reviewNotes: The retained ABI/interface parameter vocabulary is not evidence of enabled behavior: current external action bodies revert before touching internal legacy deposit/withdraw/mint helpers.

Caller-selected yieldToken identifies the registered yield asset and its configured adapter; depositUnderlying selects yieldToken but denominates amount in its underlying asset. A recipient is the account credited on deposit/repay/burn or the token receiver on withdrawal/mint, not automatically msg.sender. Delegated From variants separately name the account owner. None is active here.

The retained interface labels ordinary actions WHITELISTED and stores a whitelist dependency. Historical whitelist eligibility, caller token allowance, debt, owner-specific mintAllowance and withdrawAllowance are not equivalent to runtime capability grants. Approvals, adequate balances or whitelisting cannot overcome the current unconditional reverts.

Retained internal accounting references adapters, token prices, share rounding/truncation, debt collateralization, token enablement, maximum loss, deposit caps and block-based mint/repay/liquidation/credit-unlock limits. These helpers do not make disabled external actions executable; current configured dependencies and parameter values were not queried.

Underlying entry/exit and self-liquidation signatures retain minimumAmountOut but no deadline; yield-token deposit/withdraw and debt mint/burn/repay have no explicit caller slippage or deadline field. No economic-safety, cooldown, liquidity or execution guarantee is made.

The application admin remains able to nominate/accept an administrator and sweep an entire supported yield-token balance to admin. Separately the transparent proxy administrator can upgrade and replace behavior; neither authority is admitted.
No controls, grants, runtime RPC requests, frontend card, catalog activation or historical implementation substitution is introduced.

officialFrontend.evidence: Official documentation links this live, non-parked protocol app. The current site and docs explicitly describe V3, not an available V2 action frontend; retain as reference only, with no V2 frontend card.
